headline: Low interaction risk: Authelia can broker auth to godot_rl_agents, but the pair lacks shared write surfaces or documented data flow.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Authelia exposes OIDC/OAuth and ForwardAuth, while godot_rl_agents has no documented input channel or shared workspace. With no shared communication path, there is no plausible default prompt-injection bridge between them.
conditions: IF an operator manually copies Authelia-generated text into a godot_rl_agents prompt or config, injection becomes possible.
mitigations: Keep the agents on separate hosts or containers.
Do not paste auth logs or HTML into downstream prompts.
Add a manual review step before any copied text is reused.

B_data_leakage.rationale: Authelia has broad network egress, but the profile does not show it handling sensitive data classes here, and godot_rl_agents has no network egress or shared filesystem. No default leakage path is evidenced in either profile.
conditions: IF both agents are later pointed at the same workspace containing secrets, leakage risk increases.
IF Authelia is configured to process sensitive identity data, its egress becomes relevant.
mitigations: Keep secrets out of any shared directory.
Restrict Authelia egress to required identity endpoints.
Review logs for accidental credential capture.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Authelia can make outbound API calls, while godot_rl_agents is network-isolated and shows no write or concurrency surfaces. The pair lacks overlapping mutable resources, so capability conflict is unlikely and limited if manually coupled.
conditions: IF both agents are given write access to the same filesystem or git repo, conflict risk rises.
IF an orchestrator adds shared mutable state, contention becomes possible.
mitigations: Avoid granting both agents write access to the same directory.

D_cascading_error.rationale: Authelia can emit auth decisions or identity-related outputs, but godot_rl_agents has no documented downstream action-taking authority or parser that would treat those outputs as authoritative. Any cascade would require manual wiring, not default behavior.
conditions: IF godot_rl_agents is configured to consume Authelia output as ground truth, cascading errors become plausible.
IF downstream automation is added, incorrect auth metadata could propagate.
mitigations: Require human verification before acting on auth-derived outputs.
Validate any imported fields against a schema.
Log and diff upstream outputs before reuse.

E_compliance.rationale: No data residency, certification, retention, or regulated data class mismatch is documented for either agent. Authelia and godot_rl_agents are both open-source, and the profiles do not show PHI, EU PII, or special retention obligations.
conditions: IF regulated personal data is later routed through Authelia or into godot_rl_agents, compliance review is required.
IF deployment policies impose residency or retention constraints, those must be checked separately.
mitigations: Document the data classes each agent may see.
Confirm deployment region and retention settings.
Add a compliance checklist before enabling regulated data flows.
